originals.ko: 완벽한 집을 찾아내다
내 어머니의 완벽한 집의 새 침대 위에
originals.why: Grammatical genitive chain, and tŷ means house here. The phrase is odd but acceptable.

originals.ko: 완벽한 집의 새 침대 위에
나는 식당에서 네 자매와 이야기하고 싶어하는 젊은 남자를 알아
originals.why: Wrong sense: tŷ bwyta is a fixed compound meaning restaurant, not house. The learner has 집 and 먹다 but nothing that yields tŷ bwyta from 식당 (bwyty is just as possible).

originals.ko: 식당에서 만나다
originals.why: Wrong sense: tŷ bwyta (restaurant) does not use tŷ as the taught 집, and no taught gloss leads to it.
